requirement_text.REQ-070: Router decomposition into per-subsystem sub-routers (OQ-1). 6 acceptance criteria. All design, implementation, security, idiom, and test-design gates PASSED. Full suite must pass.

task.description:
WF-02 Step 4 — Test run for REQ-070.

Run the FULL mix test suite (not just the new router tests). Re-derive the results yourself — do not trust any prior agent's report.

Preconditions to verify before running:
1. git branch --show-current == feature/WF02-REQ070-20260821
2. The Postgres container (letflow-3-postgres-1) is running and healthy on port 5482. Check with: docker compose ps. If not running: docker compose up -d. Wait for (healthy) status before running tests.
3. Run MIX_ENV=test mix ecto.migrate (or confirm migrations are up to date) before mix test.

Run:
  mix test

(or /c/Program Files/Elixir/bin/mix test if bare mix is not on PATH)

Expected: all tests pass, including the 10 new router_test.exs tests for REQ-070. Report:
- Total test count and pass/fail
- Any failures: classify as (a) REQ-070 regression or (b) pre-existing unrelated failure
- For (b): forward to docs/agents/protocols/ISSUE_QUEUE.md as a new issue, do NOT block this run's PASS verdict on a pre-existing failure
- For (a): set result.status FAIL and rework the responsible agent

IMPORTANT — Unblock-Everything rule: if a pre-existing failure masks REQ-070's results, fix it before reporting. If you cannot fix it in this turn, classify it, forward it to the issue queue, and report the REQ-070 tests' own status as PASS if they pass.

Complete the handoff: status COMPLETED, result.status PASS or FAIL, report the actual test count and result, next_action 'Route to RELEASE-VALIDATOR (Step 5)' on PASS. Commit the completed handoff on branch feature/WF02-REQ070-20260821 by explicit path.
acceptance_criteria: Full mix test suite run (not just router_test.exs)
No regressions introduced by REQ-070's changes
Pre-existing failures forwarded to issue queue rather than blocking this run
